chapter_title: Chương 51: Bốn nữ sinh, năm nhóm trò chuyện

segments.title: Chương 51: Bốn nữ sinh, năm nhóm trò chuyện
segments.content:
This long-distance bus station was built three years ago.

With an investment of sixty million yuan, it was constructed in a particularly grand style and came with attached dining and lodging facilities.

Chen Guiliang quickly bought another ticket. When he returned to his seat in the waiting hall, he found that Bian Guanyue was gone.

After waiting for two minutes, Bian Guanyue reappeared, holding a bottle of Nongfu Orchard juice.

She had already bought two bottles earlier; this one was obviously for Tao Xue.

"You like drinking Nongfu Orchard?" Chen Guiliang asked, sitting on the chair with his eyes fixed on the entrance to the waiting hall.

Bian Guanyue said, "I've never had it before. I just see it on TV a lot."

Following the "shake it before you drink it" slogan from the commercial, she shook the bottle a few times, twisted open the cap, and took a sip. She frowned and said, "I don't really like it. The taste is a bit strange."

Chen Guiliang chuckled. "Some other time, I'll treat you to some White Flower Snake Grass Water."

"What kind of drink is that?" Bian Guanyue asked.

Chen Guiliang gave a simple introduction. "A healthy and delicious beverage rich in traditional Chinese medicinal essences."

Bian Guanyue committed the name to memory.

After a bit of small talk, Chen Guiliang spotted a petite figure stealthily entering the waiting hall.

What a child!

Tao Xue was following behind a tall stranger, thinking she was well hidden. As soon as she entered the waiting hall, she immediately crouched down, hid behind a row of chair backs, and quickly moved to a corner on the side.

There weren't many people in the waiting hall, so Tao Xue quickly spotted Chen Guiliang and Bian Guanyue.

Why is that pretty upperclassman here too?

Tao Xue couldn't help but pout, her mood turning a little sour.

But she quickly recovered, continuing to approach cautiously. In a flash, she had circled around behind the two of them.

"Roar!"

Tao Xue spread her hands like claws, pouncing on the back of the chair between them like a little tiger hunting its prey.

"Ah!"

Bian Guanyue cried out in alarm, genuinely startled.

"Haha, scared you, didn't I?" Tao Xue was quite pleased with herself.

Bian Guanyue didn't know whether to laugh or cry.

She currently had some feelings for Chen Guiliang and had subconsciously seen Tao Xue as a potential romantic rival. But it turned out this rival was just a little kid who was still playing pranks on people even though she was already in her first year of high school.

"Hey, big nephew, how come you weren't scared?" Tao Xue asked.

Chen Guiliang shoved the drink into her hands and said irritably, "Senior Bian bought this for you. Hurry up and apologize!"

Tao Xue stuck out her tongue and sat down next to Bian Guanyue. "Senior, I'm sorry. I scared you just now."

"It's okay," Bian Guanyue said.

A battleground of love rivals?

Not a chance.

Chen Guiliang wasn't dating anyone; they were all just innocent male and female classmates, an upperclassman and an underclassman.

The two girls even left him out, chattering away with each other.

Of course, it was mostly Tao Xue doing the talking.

Tao Xue asked, "Senior, why did you two change seats? I remember you used to be deskmates."

"It was rearranged based on our grades," Bian Guanyue said.

Tao Xue twisted open the bottle cap. "Thanks for the drink."

"You're welcome."

Bian Guanyue didn't say much because she wasn't familiar with Tao Xue. But she couldn't help but ask, her curiosity getting the better of her, "Why do you call him big nephew?"

Tao Xue said, puffing up with pride, "My older brother and his granduncle are classmates. So by generation, isn't he my nephew?"

"Oh."

Once Bian Guanyue understood the reason, she lost interest in talking.

Tao Xue patted her chest and said magnanimously, "It's fine. We'll stick to our own terms. I'll still call you senior. Whenever you come to the city in the future, just give me a call!"

"Okay," Bian Guanyue replied.

After saying this, Tao Xue got a little stuck, not knowing what to talk about with Bian Guanyue.

And Bian Guanyue didn't initiate conversation.

Chen Guiliang spoke up at the right moment. "I bought you a bus ticket."

"Thanks," Tao Xue said, reaching out to take it.

Chen Guiliang asked, "What book have you been reading lately?"

"The Universe in a Nutshell." Tao Xue pulled it out of her school bag.

Chen Guiliang said, "You're a girl of literature. Why are you reading popular science books?"

"I read everything. Have you read this book too?" Tao Xue asked with a grin.

Chen Guiliang said, "I've read it, but I've forgotten the content. I only remember something about black holes, string theory, and time travel."

Tao Xue said admiringly, "Hawking is amazing, a genius scientist!"

Chen Guiliang felt quite wicked. Why was it that as soon as Hawking was mentioned, he thought of a certain little island?

On that island, Hawking was cured of his ALS that had plagued him for years.

Seeing that Bian Guanyue had stopped talking and seemed to have become an outsider, he asked her, "Do you know who Hawking is?"

"I've heard of him, but I don't know much about him," Bian Guanyue said.

Chen Guiliang, trying to make conversation, said, "Let's each use eight characters to describe Hawking's life. How about it?"

"I'll go first, I'll go first."

Tao Xue raised her hand like an elementary school student. "A genius bestowed by heaven, disabled in body but steadfast in will."

Bian Guanyue twisted open her bottle cap and thought carefully while drinking her juice. "Hmm... Exceedingly intelligent, open-minded and optimistic."

"Your turn," Tao Xue said, looking at Chen Guiliang with anticipation.

Chen Guiliang said, "He knows the astronomy above, and he knows the..."

He paused intentionally here.

Tao Xue mocked, "What's that? You're describing Zhuge Liang."

"Paralysis below," Chen Guiliang added another two words.

"Pfft!"

Bian Guanyue truly had a low threshold for laughter. Hearing such a dark joke, she spat out the drink in her mouth.

He knows the astronomy above, and has lower-body paralysis?

Dark lines appeared on Tao Xue's forehead. She felt it was so childish.

But she didn't stop to think that scaring someone from behind just now was even more childish.

"Yours doesn't count!" Tao Xue said angrily.

Chen Guiliang glanced at the electronic clock on the waiting hall wall. "It's about time."

After speaking, he started walking toward the platform.

Tao Xue quickly grabbed her school bag and followed.

Bian Guanyue was still fumbling for a tissue to wipe her clothes; she had sprayed some of the drink on her pants.

Chen Guiliang was the first to board the bus, heading straight for the back row.

It wouldn't be good to sit with either of them, so he could only choose the back row. It could seat four people, while the other seats could only accommodate two.

The two girls understood the situation and left Chen Guiliang behind, choosing to sit together in the row in front of him.

Chen Guiliang smiled and shifted to lean against the window.

It was quite harmonious, at least on the surface.

After waiting for about ten minutes, the bus was only a third full.

Seeing that no more passengers were boarding, the ticket conductor went to hand in a slip, then returned and shouted for the driver to depart.

As they left the station, a staff member came to check, confirming that the number of passengers matched the number of tickets.

Less than a kilometer after leaving the bus station, the bus suddenly pulled over to the side of the road, and a flood of passengers boarded, nearly filling the bus.

Bian Guanyue asked curiously, "I always see a lot of passengers here. Why don't they go to the bus station to buy tickets and get on? They could wait in the waiting hall. There's no need to stand on the roadside in the cold wind."

"It's one yuan cheaper to get on here," Chen Guiliang explained. "The driver and conductor are happy too. They pick up passengers illegally outside, and they can pocket the ticket money."

Bian Guanyue was incredibly surprised. "It works like that? Doesn't the bus company know?"

Tao Xue was surprisingly well-informed. "Of course they know. They have to pay a tribute every month."

Bian Guanyue opened her mouth to speak but then stopped. She felt this wasn't right.

Tao Xue said sarcastically, "A friend of my dad's drives a long-distance bus. He used to come to our house for dinner a lot. When he got drunk, he'd brag about how much extra he could make. He also said some people were too corrupt, demanding more than half as tribute."

"More than half? That is pretty corrupt," Chen Guiliang commented.

Tao Xue suddenly found a topic and began to tell all sorts of secret stories, not limited to the bus company.

Things like getting kickbacks from procurement, or bribing their way through back doors.

The literary girl was quite the gossip.

Bian Guanyue had never encountered such things before. She was shocked but also listened with great interest, occasionally chiming in with a couple of questions.

They chatted all the way until they got off in the county town.

Chen Guiliang and Tao Xue directly transferred to a city bus to go to school.

Bian Guanyue, however, had to go home first.

"Senior, what's your phone number?" Tao Xue asked.

Bian Guanyue took out her phone and they exchanged contact information. In the end, they even exchanged QQ numbers.

Chen Guiliang stood by and watched, feeling a cold wind at his back.

It felt like an ominous sign!

"Goodbye, senior."

"Goodbye."

Bian Guanyue's bus arrived first. She waved goodbye and got on.

She sat by the window, looking back at the two of them standing by the roadside until the bus moved forward and they disappeared from sight.

When she got home, her grandparents weren't there. They were probably still out playing mahjong.

Bian Guanyue first put away her laptop, then restlessly rolled around on her bed. Finally, she sat down at her desk and opened her pencil case.

Inside the pencil case was a white, jade-like pebble.

A face was drawn on the surface of the stone, with the word "Simpleton" specially marked on it.

She thought for a moment, then added a dog's tail to the face, and after "Simpleton," she added "Shameless Dog."

After finishing the drawing, she examined it carefully and found it more and more interesting the longer she looked.

Bian Guanyue picked up her phone to send a text message, but not to Chen Guiliang. Instead, she asked Tao Xue, "Have you guys reached the school yet?"

"Just got off at the school gate," Tao Xue replied quickly.

Hopping off the bus, Chen Guiliang excitedly ran to the pharmacy by the roadside.

The female clerk already recognized him and greeted him proactively, "Hey handsome, here to weigh yourself again?"

"Yeah, sorry to bother you, beautiful," Chen Guiliang actively shared his results. "I only gained one jin and seven liang this week."

The female clerk smiled. "And here I am, worrying about how to lose weight."

"Hurry up and let me have a turn," Tao Xue wanted to join in on whatever was happening.

She pulled Chen Guiliang off and stood on the scale herself.

Chen Guiliang said, "Fat pigs that get on the scale are about to be slaughtered."

"You're the fat pig!" Tao-ayi flew into a rage.

Another text message came.

Tao Xue replied, "Chen Guiliang is a jerk!"

"Did he annoy you again?"

"He called me a fat pig. I'm so mad."

"Haha."

Chen Guiliang leaned over to look. "What are you two texting about?"

"None of your business," Tao Xue quickly turned away.

Chen Guiliang just couldn't figure it out. Why did they have to talk privately, leaving him out?

He hated it when people created small private groups!

Four girls, five group chats. It really wasn't just a saying.
